Load a real DejaVuSans outline, then let the ABI test-support owner expand its owned vectors to 65,536 points before invoking the existing render-failure helper. This is an explicitly synthetic internal-state probe for the helper's FT_UShort conversion failure; it does not claim that public FreeType constructs or accepts an oversized outline.

metadata.coverage_intent: Exercise safe defensive exits in the maintained C-ABI/WASM outline mutation helpers. Null means the documented zero handle, glyph 3 is a valid empty public outline, and the two Batch274 cases use a real outline before deliberately entering private ABI bookkeeping states.
metadata.oracle_verdict: Pinned FT_Glyph_To_Bitmap validates null handles at freetype/src/base/ftglyph.c:786-803, while the smooth renderer treats an empty outline as a successful no-op at freetype/src/smooth/ftgrays.c:1981-1989. The Batch274 oversized-vector and non-SVG probes are explicitly Fontdone safety extensions: pinned FreeType has no public operation that creates those helper-only states, so the oracle records the required false result rather than asserting a C mutation call.

metadata.source_behavior: Pinned FT_Outline_Check at freetype/src/base/ftoutln.c:351-393 deliberately omits tag validation; FT_Outline_Decompose in freetype/src/smooth/ftgrays.c:1480-1685 rejects malformed cubic and conic sequences during rendering.
metadata.expansion_reason: Batch 236 is the first public FT_Glyph_To_Bitmap family that keeps counts and contour endpoints valid while corrupting only the public tags. The 30 cases separate normal, overlap-normal, and SDF renderer entry points, three pinned decomposition failures, multiple glyph boxes, sizes, and both destroy values so every retained input has a distinct reachability or ownership reason.
metadata.oracle_verdict: Pinned FreeType does not unknowingly accept these records: the public outline pre-check passes them because it does not inspect tags, and the renderer returns FT_Err_Invalid_Outline from its decomposition stage.
